Figure 2: Figure (a) illustrates the power curves of the two solutions γl, γh of Eq. 3, calculated with α = 0.05, δ = 2, and n = 50. The two curves intersect at one point. At power levels above the intersection, γh achieves equivalent power with lower DKL. Figure (b) extends the calculation to a wide range of δ ∈ (0.5, 8) by plotting the power at the corresponding intersection point. Each δ corresponds to one intersection point. We observe a monotonically decreasing pattern, with maximum power below 0.8.
